newsitem.title: USA: Guard killed in violent St. Louis bank robbery.
newsitem.headline: Guard killed in violent St. Louis bank robbery.

text.p: Two men wearing body armour and firing automatic weapons killed a security guard during a bank robbery Monday and then led police on a chase in which one of the robbers was captured, police said.

The incident occurred at the Lindell Bank & Trust Co. in the western section of St. Louis. Police said the men sprayed the bank lobby with fire from AK-47 rifles, killing a guard. They escaped with an undetermined amount of money.

The two fled in a van on U.S. 40 but crashed into a tree when the van ran off the road in Forest Park. The van burst into flames and police were able to capture one man at the scene while the other fled into the park.
The FBI said the men were wearing bullet-proof vests and leg guards.
It was the latest in a series of violent incidents at banks in the United States in recent days.
Last week a man in Detroit who police said may have been bent more on mayhem than robbery killed two bank employees and a hostage before police killed him.
In California last month two would-be bank robbers wearing body armour were killed by police after shooting up a North Hollywood neighbourhood.
